title: Mineral Salt Medium \(MSM) for extreme acidophilic microorganisms
protocol: Mix 3.0 g/l (NH4)2SO4, 3.2 g/l Na2SO4·10H2O, 0.1 g/l KCl, 0.05 g/l K2HPO4, 0.5 g/l MgSO4·7H2O, and 0.01 g/l Ca(NO3)2 in a final volume of 1 liter of water.
Dissolve each constituent before adding the next one.
Adjust the pH to 2.0 with sulfuric acid (and/or sodium hydroxide).
